task.title: Testing the SSL/TLS configuration using a browser
task.shortdesc: To test your SSL/TLS configuration in a browser, you can open your Red Hat Quay registry endpoint and review the connection warnings for a self-signed certificate. Expected browser warnings confirm that TLS is active before you trust the certificate authority on clients.

step.cmd: Navigate to your Red Hat Quay registry endpoint, for example, https://quay-server.example.com. If configured correctly, the browser warns of the potential risk:
